summary: The patch addresses the issue of pickling errors when using non-pickleable types in Q objects but introduces potential regressions and lacks comprehensive testing.

issues.description: The conversion to list may inadvertently alter the behavior of Q objects when used with certain iterable types, potentially breaking existing code.
While the patch fixes the specific issue, it does not include additional tests to cover various iterable types and their interactions with Q objects.
The conversion logic could be more clearly documented and structured, especially regarding why certain types need conversion.
